name: MSR26 CMS
audience: Students finding assignment links and contacting professors when they need help.
promise: Your coursework and professor contacts, in one place.
headline: Less searching. More studying.

design_direction: An organized student field guide: navy ink, warm paper, teal accents, generous spacing and clearly separated task sections. AI-proposed visual direction for the agreed Sage identity.
